extracted_incidents.description: Incidents of the target category found in the document. Returns an empty array if the category does not appear.

contextual_meaning.description: Steps 1 & 2: Critical analysis of what this manifestation means in its textual context without leaving anything aside.

revealed_property.description: Step 3: The specific feature or property of the category that this incident reveals.

incident_summary.description: Step 4: A compact, precise one-sentence summary of the incident in simple language, avoiding academic jargon.

exact_quotes.description: Step 5: Exact, verbatim quotes from the text that show how the incident manifests in real life. Do not paraphrase.

classification.description: Step 6: Classification of how the incident relates to the current definition of the category.

classification_rationale.description: Step 6: A short rationale connecting the classification choice to the meaning of the category.
